test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Identify the correct option from given statements:****Assertion (A):** The 37th National Games in Goa saw participation from all Indian States and Union Territories.**Reason (R):** Over 10,000 sportspersons, coaches, and officials participated in this edition of the Games.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• **Assertion (A)** is correct because the **37th National Games**, held in **Goa** in **2023**, witnessed participation from all **28 Indian States** and **8 Union Territories**, along with the **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)**.

• **Reason (R)** is also correct as the event was one of the largest sporting spectacles in India, involving more than **10,000 sportspersons**, coaches, and technical officials.

• While both statements are factually accurate, the **Reason (R)** does not explain the **Assertion (A)**. The participation of all states and UTs is a structural requirement and a matter of national representation in the **National Games of India**, whereas the total number of participants is a measure of the scale and the number of sporting disciplines included in that specific edition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **37th National Games** were officially inaugurated by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** at the **Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** in Fatorda, Goa.

• The official mascot for this edition was **Moga**, which represents an **Indian Bison** (Gaur).

• **Maharashtra** finished at the top of the medal table, winning the **Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy** with a total of **228 medals** (80 Gold, 69 Silver, and 79 Bronze).

• The games featured a record **43 sporting disciplines**, including the debut of sports like **Beach Football**, **Rollball**, **Golf**, **Sepak Takraw**, and **Kalaripayattu**.

• The **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** secured the second position in the overall medal tally.

• The **38th edition** of the National Games is scheduled to be hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand**.
